resources.string: Use the direction buttons and OK to change the overlay. Open Hearth controls from your TV apps whenever you need it.

The overlay is temporarily out of the way while this screen is open. Return to viewing to see your changes. Hide only hides the overlay; speech and read-aloud continue. Stop ends capture and read-aloud.
Captions are running. Open Overlay & speech controls to hide, pause, move or stop them.

Open Hearth controls from your TV apps using the remote. You can hide or show captions, pause speech, adjust the overlay, or stop and close Hearth there. Custom system Quick Settings tiles depend on your TV software.

The Live captions tile starts captions when off and stops capture and read-aloud when on. Open Overlay & speech controls to hide or adjust the overlay while speech continues. Starting checks setup and asks for Android permissions.
Open overlay controls to hide, show, move, pause or stop captions.
Remote controls and Quick Settings tiles
Use the side categories, then move across to the options. Changes save automatically.
The preview stays visible while you scroll the options. It shows sample captions, not a live capture.
This is where your captions will appear.
